data.summary: This 10‑week plan starts with the student’s weak units, interleaves new material, and ends with mixed review and timed practice. Each week is limited to 5 study hours and includes concrete tasks that can be completed in one sitting.

weeks.focus: Review Kinematics fundamentals and practice vector problems
tasks: Do 15 vector addition problems and check solutions
Solve 10 one‑dimensional kinematics word problems
Create a summary sheet of key formulas

weeks.focus: Deep dive into Linear Momentum with live class
tasks: Watch live class 1 and take notes
Do 10 impulse‑momentum problems
Explain conservation of momentum in a 2‑body collision example
Draw free‑body diagrams for 5 scenarios
Solve 10 Newton’s second law problems
Create a cheat sheet of force components
Calculate work done in 8 different situations
Relate kinetic energy to speed in 5 examples
Plot potential energy curves for 3 systems

weeks.focus: Torque and Rotational Dynamics with live class
tasks: Watch live class 2 and summarize key points
Solve 10 torque problems with different lever arms
Apply conservation of angular momentum to a rotating disk

weeks.focus: Energy and Momentum of Rotating Systems
tasks: Compute rotational kinetic energy for 4 objects
Relate torque to work in 5 examples
Solve 8 angular impulse problems
Derive SHM equations for a mass‑spring system
Calculate frequency and period for 5 oscillators
Plot energy vs. time for 3 SHM cases
Calculate pressure at different depths in 4 fluids
Solve 6 buoyancy problems
Draw diagrams of fluid flow in 3 scenarios
Do a 30‑question timed quiz covering all units
Review incorrect answers and update summary sheets
Create a concept map linking all topics
Take a full-length 60‑minute practice exam
Analyze performance and identify weak areas
Plan last‑minute review schedule

data.final_week_advice: In the final week, focus on timed practice, review mistakes, and reinforce exam strategies such as time management and question prioritization.
